title: A Letter About Your Investment Portfolio
titleZh: 關於您投資組合的信函
paragraphs: Thank you for your continued trust in our investment service. Over the past year, your portfolio delivered a return of 6.8 percent, slightly above the average yield for similar accounts. Most of the gain came from stock holdings, while the bond portion added steady but modest income.

Given current market conditions, we recommend keeping the same balance between stock and bond for now. Interest rates remain a key risk, since a sudden increase could lower bond prices. We will continue to monitor your fund and send an updated statement each quarter.
If you would like to discuss your dividend income or adjust your risk level, please contact our office. We are happy to arrange a call at a convenient time.
Best regards, David Chen, Investment Advisor

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this letter?
options: To report on the performance of an investment portfolio and offer advice
To announce a new investment product launch
To request additional funds from a client
To apologize for a delay in a fund transfer

questions.stem: What was the return delivered by the portfolio over the past year?
What is suggested about a sudden increase in interest rates?
options: It would likely raise bond prices
It would have no effect on the portfolio
It would increase the dividend amount
